patterns.name: hybrid_beats_flat_fee_under_attribution_uncertainty
patterns.description: Hybrid creator compensation (base + performance) has outperformed flat-fee renewal in comparable creator-renewal decisions where prior commerce performance was promising but attribution confidence was uncertain.

patterns.name: bfcm_paid_placement_uplift
patterns.description: Paid placements booked with top affiliate publishers during BFCM have shown outsized revenue uplift versus the prior-month baseline across the portfolio.
strongest_conditions: publisher already has an established relationship
placement booked at least 3 weeks before BFCM

patterns.name: coupon_concentration_margin_risk
patterns.description: Clients with high revenue concentration in coupon/loyalty publishers have shown gradual margin erosion versus clients with a more diversified publisher mix, across the portfolio.
strongest_conditions: coupon/loyalty share of attributed revenue above 40%
